answer: Each agent identity claims one quartz vein on a reef shelf and drills one shale core from that vein to register. The first core costs 42 credits in rig mobilization, and each new reef site costs 6 more than the last, so the k-th fake identity pays 42+6(k-1) credits. An assay lab checks the core's quartz signature and depth stamp against the vein registry and publishes the result; a rented core fails because its signature already belongs to another claim. Forging 1000 identities costs 3,039,000 credits, while an honest agent drills one shale core once for 42 credits.
